name: Active Controllers
description: kafka_controller_kafkacontroller_value{name=ActiveControllerCount}. Exactly 1 is healthy; 0 or 2+ indicates a split-brain or leaderless controller.
programText: data('kafka_controller_kafkacontroller_value', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-controller') and filter('name', 'ActiveControllerCount')).publish(label='Active Controllers')
